headerDisplay: Philips Air+ purifiers through the Philips cloud (same protocol as the Air+ app and Google Home). Log in with the email of your Philips account; a verification code will be sent there.

email.title: Philips account email
email.description: For reference only — log in from the panel above.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Filled in automatically by the login panel (or by the philips-airplus-login command).

clientId.title: OAuth client id
clientId.description: Filled in automatically. Air+ app client unless your account only works with the HomeID app.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Leave empty to add every purifier in the account. Add entries to pick devices or rename them.

displayLight.title: Show the display light as a dimmable light
displayLight.description: Appears once the purifier reports its light setting.

displayLightProperty.title: Display light property (advanced)
displayLightProperty.description: Only if the light does not appear: the property key that holds the light setting, as shown in the log line 'Status properties reported by the device'.

pollInterval.title: Status refresh interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: The device also pushes changes in real time; this is only a safety net.

logDeviceData.title: Log all device data (diagnostics)
logDeviceData.description: At startup, ask the purifier for all its ports and cloud shadow and write them to the log. Turn off again afterwards.
